name: Soul Search
label: Revelation
lede: A California hardcore band that built its name one 7" at a time on four different labels, then got picked up by Revelation for a reissue.

eras.title: Tape first, then vinyl
eras.text: Soul Search came up through the California hardcore scene of the early 2010s the old way: a cassette, then small-run 7"s on the labels that mattered in that world.

years.h: Soul Search record Intolerable Weight in Los Angeles
years.p: Five songs, including Depth and Wretch, cut at Earth Capital Recordings in Los Angeles in May 2010. It circulates first on cassette through several small labels.
The cassette becomes the first release on Thick Skin Records.
Four songs in under nine minutes, engineered by Taylor Young. Triple-B pressed it three times, the last in 2021.

years.h: Full set filmed by hate5six, August 12, 2012
yt: Full set filmed by hate5six, August 12, 2012

eras.title: Three guitars and a Revelation reissue
eras.text: By 2013 Soul Search had three guitar players. Their strongest record came out on a small label and was picked up by Revelation a year later.

years.h: Nothing But a Nightmare on Back To Back Records
years.p: Five songs with three guitarists, Aaron Chavez, Nick Evans and Ricky Duarte, over Alfredo Gutierrez's bass and Dorian Zambrano's drums. Mattias Frisk draws the cover.

years.h: Revelation reissues Nothing But a Nightmare as Rev155
years.p: Revelation re-presses the 7": 1,100 copies on dark grey and 550 on light grey.

years.h: Soul Search split a 7" with Minus on Closed Casket Activities
years.p: Omar Gonzalez sings Damned To Be and Price of Freedom. Closed Casket presses 800 on red, 500 clear and 200 clear with red splatter.
